candidates.title: Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures
candidates.summary: Tool-augmented LLM agents discover relevant APIs from large registries before planning execution, yet finite context windows prohibit injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt. candidates.title: Can we prove this: the code submitted with this research paper actually produced the numbers reported?
candidates.summary:
Let me make this short for the sake of saving people time…

Imagine something that aims to solve these problem for reviewers (in peer-review or research in general):

  • “I cannot re-rerun the code to verify if it works and it gives the scores reported in the paper”.

  • “Can we bind the results to the computations that produce them in a nonrepudiable way?”

Appreciate your inputs (after testing it of course)!! View it only on what it aims to address, not verifying whether or not the science of the papers is correct.

Do Muon and Dion3 retain their convergence advantages over Adam under practical training conditions?
